meta.description: Incident-to-benchmark mapping for agentic AI / MCP / A2A security tests. Based on OWASP ASI incident categories and public incident patterns referenced by the project documentation.

incidents.name: Malicious MCP Package Backdoor
incidents.summary: Backdoored MCP package gives persistent remote access or data exfiltration capability in agent environments.

incidents.name: Framelink Figma MCP RCE style vulnerability
incidents.summary: Unsanitized user-controlled input in an MCP tool leads to command execution on the host.

incidents.name: MCP OAuth Response Poisoning
incidents.summary: Untrusted MCP OAuth response injects agent-executed commands or poisoned connection state after authentication.

incidents.name: Malicious MCP Server Impersonating Postmark
incidents.summary: Look-alike MCP server impersonates a legitimate service and secretly BCCs or exfiltrates data.

incidents.name: ForcedLeak / Agentforce indirect prompt injection
incidents.summary: External prompt injection steers a business agent to exfiltrate CRM records.

incidents.name: Agent-in-the-Middle / forged agent card
incidents.summary: Rogue peer advertises forged high-trust capabilities and intercepts sensitive multi-agent tasks.

incidents.name: Coding agent config overwrite / RCE
incidents.summary: Prompted coding agent writes dangerous workspace configuration that executes commands on open/run.

incidents.name: Cross-context memory or retrieval poisoning
incidents.summary: Poisoned context, issue text, or shared memory causes future sessions or agents to leak private content.
